**Performance: pass** at `e402ddef80ea44dd2e2fa08c58eec157cdfe7eff`.

Phase-1 delta against `0c4078197c34fdf09d769b87c347b6fabb87e44c`: schemas/fixtures, docs, templates and tests. The only production-code change adds six fixed catalog entries: **28 embedded versions, still 16 names**. Catalog algorithms are unchanged; construction/lookup has a small fixed metadata/byte footprint increase, listing still parses 16 latest bodies, and show selects one body. Hash pins are test-only.

**No new recurring launch, poll, timer, hook, SQL query or daemon loop.** No dependency change or migration. Phase-2 moves/code and the coverage/umbrella-completeness sensor are explicitly deferred in the evidence; this pass does not grade them as shipped.

Exact head is CLEAN. [CI 42390049084](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42390049084) passes all four jobs: **2,110 Rust cases passed**, five skipped separately. JUnit confirms version pins, byte-exact embedding, latest-template HTTP and command-coverage tests executed. Latest delivers **42390094187** passes; **42390049071** was cancelled.

No local builds, tests, probes, model calls or worktree edits. No new deployment measurement obligation for this fixed-catalog/documentation phase.
